An additional PC in the reprocessing room and external software for release is not required. The labels contain information about the device and sterilization program, the sterilization date, the daily and total batch, the storage period of the sterilized instrument, if applicable the personnel numbers of the persons who started the sterilization, released instruments for use and printed the label as well as a barcode for convenient digital documentation in your practice.In addition, MELAprint 80 can also be used as a log printer for the new Pro and Prime Line as well as for older device generations (e.g. Profi class, Euroklav, MELAquick 12+ and MELAtronic® 15 EN+).

When the sterilization program has been completed successfully, and clearance is seen on the screen of the steam sterilizer, labels are printed with the MELAprint 60 for labelling the wrapped instruments. products.name: MELAnet Box

The MELAnet Box contains its own web server, which loads websites into the practice network. The user is then able to see logs of processes already finished or ongoing in real time, in any selected computer connected to the practice"s network.

products.name: Chamber Protect Cleaning Set

The set includes a powerful cleaner specially developed for cleaning stainless steel surfaces. It effectively removes dirt, residues and impurities without damaging the chamber. The formula is gentle yet extremely effective. In addition to the cleaner, 50 lint-free cloths are included in the scope of delivery, which are perfectly suited to cleaning autoclave kettles. These cloths ensure thorough cleaning without leaving any residue or lint, which ensures a flawless surface. A microfiber cloth rounds off the set and enables streak-free drying and polishing of the cleaned surfaces.

products.name: MELAdem 40
products.description: MELAdem 40 enables the economical production of demineralised water (aqua dem) in practice. (aqua dem) in practice. According to the principle of ion exchange principle, ions that contaminate tap water (e.g. calcium, magnesium etc.) are exchanged for hydrogen and hydroxide ions. In this way, MELAdem 40 supplies high-quality feed water for the automatic supply of MELAG steam sterilisers of the premium class. steam sterilisers of the premium class, the Pro / Prime Line and the Euroklav and SteriHero series.

products.name: MELAdem 47
products.description: Increasing hygiene requirements in the processing of medical products can involve the frequent sterilizing of instruments. The consequent increased need for high quality demineralised water is provided amply by the MELAdem 47 and at low cost. The reversal of the physical principle of osmosis is an extremely environmentally-friendly type of water processing. MELAdem 47 produces around 3-5 litres of feed water per hour, so that several MELAG steam sterilizers can be supplied at the same time.

products.name: MELAdem 53
products.description: The MELAdem 53 works in accordance with the tried and tested ion exchange procedure, generating high-quality demineralized water for the cleaning, disinfection and sterilization process. It has been conceived to satisfy a requirement for large volumes of aqua dem e.g. for the supply of the Cliniclave, MELAtherm and one or more practice steam sterilizers. The scope of delivery consists of two high-value cartridges filled with regeneratable resin, one of which is connected to the steam sterilizer and/or the MELAtherm. Once the cartridge has been exhausted, it is dispatched for regeneration and the second cartridge is brought into operation. The MELAdem 53 represents the standard water treatment unit for practices requiring large quantities of demineralized water. The high-performance of the MELAdem 53 enables the connection of one or more steam sterilizers in addition to the MELAtherm. Given an average water hardness of the tap water, the capacity of a cartridge is sufficient for c. 2,800 litres of high-quality demineralized water.Do you already own a MELAdem? Then get your MELAdem 53 regeneration now for just €240 using our form.

products.name: MELAdem 53 C

products.name: MELAjet spray pistol

products.name: MELAcontrol Helix
products.description: The new MELAcontrol Helix – Reliable Routine Testing for Class B Autoclaves The MELAcontrol Helix is a professional solution for reliable routine monitoring of Class B autoclaves. The Helix test was developed in accordance with the strict requirements of the European standard DIN EN ISO 11140 and offers a validated and compliant method for testing steam penetration in hollow instruments—a crucial factor for effective sterilization. By simulating the most challenging load conditions within the sterilization process, the Helix delivers highly meaningful test results and ensures maximum process reliability. A clear color change from blue to pink after successful sterilization enables fast, unambiguous evaluation and supports reliable documentation.✅ Fully compliant with ISO 11140✅ Reliable verification of steam penetration✅ Clear visual result for quick decision-making✅ High process safety with minimal time investment✅ Economical and sustainable solution for routine control To ensure consistently high test quality, every reorder of indicator strips includes a new Helix test body. This guarantees long-term reliability in batch monitoring while minimizing administrative effort.

products.name: MELAcontrol Pro

This test body is required for batch monitoring of the processing of "critical B" instruments. MELAcontrol Pro with 40 indicator strips is a durable, usable test body for the power-user. The test strips can be re-ordered in a refill package with 250 indicator strips.

products.name: MELAcontrol Type 5 Indicator

If the sterilisation conditions are observed, the indicator turns over after 16.5 min at 121 °C or after 3,5 min at 134 °C. The ready-to-use indicator is for single use and is supplied in a practical box with 250 indicator strips.

products.name: MELAcontrol Bowie & Dick Test
products.description: MELAcontrol Bowie & Dick Test (Size: 11.4 cm x 11.4 cm) is a test system according to EN ISO 11140-1 (type 2) for routine control of the steam penetration of your autoclave. The practical test package simulates a laundry package weighing several kilograms being sterilized in an autoclave with fractionated pre-vacuum. The successful color change of the indicator in the test package takes place at 134 °C after 3.5 min. 1 test package is included in the scope of delivery. The handling of the MELAcontrol Bowie & Dick test is very simple: Place the test package at the desired position in the load. Run the sterilization program and then check the result. With sufficient steam penetration, the indicator turns from yellow to black.

The new AquaBoost technology ensures optimal cleaning outcomes: AquaBoost makes for double rinsing pressure and up to 44 % better cleaning results. The increased pressure permits the decontamination of even more instruments.

products.name: Vacuklav 41 B+ Evolution
products.description: Quick, easy-to-use and stand-alone – now with DRYtelligence This high-performance practice steam sterilizer brings the same record operating times as the almost identical Vacuklav 40 B+ Evolution. Its innovative double chamber technology means the sterilization and drying of unwrapped instruments in only 10 minutes; wrapped instruments in a Class-B program require no more than 20 minutes. Both times include fractionated pre-vacuum and drying. The intelligent drying system DRYtelligence uses especially-developed algorithms to adapt the drying to the load in order to shorten the operating times even further and save resources. The Vacuklav 41 B+ Evolution is fitted with an effective air-cooling system, making it into a true stand-alone steam sterilizer as it requires no connections other than to the electricity supply.

products.name: Vacuklav 43 B+ Evolution
products.description: Premium, large and stand-alone – now with DRYtelligence The high-performance air-cooling of the Vacuklav 43 B+ Evolution makes it ideally-suited for all practices seeking a quick, large and high-performance practice steam sterilizer without a fitted water connection. A deeper sterilization chamber (45 cm) allows the acceptance of longer instrument sets than the otherwise identical Vacuklav 41 B+ Evolution permits. Very short operating times enable the use of this innovative steam sterilizer in practices seeking to decontaminate a large number of instruments in a short time. The intelligent drying system DRYtelligence uses especially-developed algorithms to adapt the drying to the load in order to shorten the operating times even further and save resources. This means that even partial loads can be decontaminated without wasting resources.

products.name: Vacuklav 44 B+ Evolution
products.description: The power-autoclave for large practices and clinics – new with DRYtelligence The larger sterilization chamber (45 cm, volume 22 l) and the water-cooled vacuum pump make the Vacuklav 44 B+ the ideal steam sterilizer for all those practices seeking to sterilize a large quantity of instruments in a short time. 20 minutes in Quick-Program “B” for the sterilization of wrapped instruments. 10 minutes in Quick-Program “S” for the sterilization of unwrapped instruments. Both times include fractionated pre-vacuum and drying. Safe sterilization and drying of a load of up to 9 kg. The unique algorithms of our intelligent drying system DRYtelligence permit the shortest possible drying time whatever the load size.

products.name: MELAstore Tray Ophthalmology
products.description: Optimize the instrument reprocessing in your ophthalmological practice or clinic with the MELAstore Tray Ophthalmology. Specifically designed for the demanding requirements of ophthalmology, the MELAstore Tray ensures maximum efficiency and safety throughout the reprocessing of your cataract surgery sets.Flexible and secure: The MELAstore Tray consists of an upper and a lower basket, equipped with flexible, positionable silicone supports. These guarantee a secure hold for both rigid and articulated instruments.Effective cleaning: The lower basket features an injection rail and versatile connections to ensure reliable cleaning and disinfection of your complex hollow instruments (e.g., phaco, irrigation, and suction handpieces).Time-saving: Instruments are inserted directly into the silicone supports after the procedure, significantly speeding up preparation and reprocessing through a standardised process.Space-saving: Up to 6 or 8 MELAstore Trays Ophthalmology can be space-efficiently placed in the universal holder of the MELAtherm 10 or MELAtherm 20 and optimally adapted for cleaning and disinfection.Protection against recontamination: After cleaning and disinfection, the upper and lower baskets are combined into a set and packed in a MELAstore Box 200. The integrated filter protects the instrument set from recontamination during storage.The MELAstore Tray Ophthalmology is only compatible with the MELAtherm 10 base basket with injection rail and plastic central filter (Art.-Nr. ME80440) or the Cleanfinity Pro (Art.-Nr. ME84650) central filter of the MELAtherm 20.

products.name: Cliniclave 45 D
products.description: Innovative double door large steam sterilizer (1 STU) with DRYtelligence® technology Decades of experience in developing solutions for instrument reprocessing lead to the most innovative large steam sterilizers: the Cliniclave-Series! The world-beating MELAG quality made in Germany means that Cliniclave 45 D outperforms many other large autoclaves. The sterilization of larger quantities of instruments and textiles and their quick availability is one of the most important requirements in practices, clinics and hospitals. The large steam sterilizer Cliniclave 45 D has the capacity of one sterilization unit (STU) to accommodate up to 35 kg of wrapped instruments. The combination of extremely short operation times with our intelligent drying system DRYtelligence® guarantees the best- possible sterilization outcomes. The patented double jacket technology of Cliniclave 45 D makes for record B-Class sterilization in 31 minutes (including drying). The pass-through technology of Cliniclave 45 D has been designed for clinics employing a multi- room concept. Fitted with a door on both the loading and removal sides, the concept of this large steam sterilizer ensures maximum safety using stream-lined working practices. The new XXL colour-touch display of Cliniclave 45 D permits easy batch approval; a CF card slot and two network interfaces enables you to choose from a range of different methods of storing log files.

products.name: MELAcontrol Ink Test
products.description: The ink test is a reliable testing device for the weekly control of sealing seams for tightness according to DIN EN ISO 11607-1 and ASTM F1929-12. The ink required for the test is contained in a practical disposable bag. The MELAcontrol Ink Test is sealed in a transparent sterilization packaging. The ink is then squeezed out of the pouch inside the packaging. With the ink now on the sealed seams, the seams on all four sides of the package can be precisely inspected. Irregularities, flaws or channels in the sealing seams quickly become visible. The ink test is particularly suitable for testing bags with side gussets.

products.name: Working table Comfort
products.description: The work table "comfort" with easy-running casters for the quick transport of heavy individual instruments and containers.

products.name: Reel dispenser for MELAseal 300
products.description: The Flex roll holder is the ideal addition to your MELAseal 300 continuous sealing device. It ensures efficient, ergonomic, and clean working when preparing the packaging process. The roll holder is flexible in use and can either be placed on the work surface or mounted on the wall to save space. This means it fits perfectly into any practice or clinic environment and offers convenient storage for various film rolls. Thanks to the integrated cutting device, the rolls can be cut to the required length effortlessly and precisely. This allows you to prepare your instruments quickly and safely for the subsequent sealing process. Dimensions (WxHxD): 50.5 × 20 × 27 cm Compatible with: MELAseal 300 and MELAseal Pro Mounting: Tabletop or wall mounting The Flex roll holder – for order, efficiency, and perfect workflows in instrument reprocessing.

products.name: MELAquick 12+
products.description: A compact quick steam sterilizer achieving record operating times for hand pieces and turbines Transmission instruments need to be decontaminated after patient treatment in a reliable sterilization process. Operating in a cost and time-efficient manner, the compact quick steam sterilizers of the MELAquick series operate in compliance with international hygiene standards. Up to 12 hand pieces and turbines, prophylactic or other instruments (up to 20 cm) can be reprocessed in only 7 minutes. The quick sterilization cycles enable you to reduce your stock of transmission instruments to a minimum. The steam sterilizer MELAquick 12+ requires a compressed air supply to ensure an efficient and standard-compliant drying process. An optional water treatment unit of the MELAdem series facilitates the workflows in your practice or clinic. The water treatment unit directly supplies quick steam sterilizer MELAquick 12+ with demineralized water. MELAG provides a variety of accessories for the documentation, batch approval and traceability of the sterilization process. Choose from the MELAprint 44 protocol printer; MELAflash CF card printer; MELAnet-Box for network connection and MELAtrace software for the complete approval, labelling and tracing of the entire instrument reprocessing procedure.

products.name: Vacuclave 323
products.description: The MELAG price-performance champion: Offers more, needs less! Whether loading, sterilization or documentation - the new Prime Line autoclave with a chamber volume of 23 liters offers a price-performance ratio that stands up any comparison: So you not only sterilize more instruments in less time, but also save a lot of money. And all this in the MELAG quality - made in Germany, that you know and love from the proven predecessor models of the Pro-Class. The MELAG price-performance champion: Vacuclave 323 combines the Pro Line product highlights with further innovations for more performance, for outstanding drying results and for complete traceability.

products.name: MELAprint 44
products.description: Sterilization logs of the following steam sterilizers can be recorded very simply with the MELAprint 44, namely the Pro-Class, the S-Class (Euroklav), the MELAtronic EN and the Cliniklav 25. It is ideal for the practice or hospital that needs or wants a direct print-out. An additional network adapter (Art. No. 40295) is necessary to connect the MELAprint 44 to the steam sterilizers of the Premium-Class or to the Vacuquick and the MELAtherm washer disinfector.
